# Bookmarks

`.projections-bookmarks.json` at the repository root: saved comparisons to revisit, each a projection and two revisions. `projections bookmark` reads it; bookmark IDs are unique within the file. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/bookmarks/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/bookmarks/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/bookmarks/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `"projections.bookmarks"` | Yes |  |
| `version` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `bookmarks` | array of [`bookmark`](#bookmark) | Yes | At most 100 items. |

No other properties are allowed.

## Definitions

### `bookmark`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [`identifier`](definition.md#identifier) | Yes | The bookmark's ID, unique in the file. |
| `title` | string | Yes | What the comparison shows. At least 1 character. At most 1000 characters. |
| `projectionId` | [`identifier`](definition.md#identifier) | Yes | The projection it compares. |
| `before` | string | Yes | The revision before: a commit, branch, tag or other Git revision. At least 1 character. At most 1024 characters. |
| `after` | string |  | The revision after; absent means the working tree. At least 1 character. At most 1024 characters. |

No other properties are allowed.
